"""Sensor-guided TidyBot controller. Only the documented RCB client is used."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def inspect():
    r=Robot()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True)
    res.save(OUT/'initial')
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    print(res.meta)

if __name__=='__main__':
    inspect()
